description: Texts where the dotless i (U+0131) or dotted capital I (U+0130) is written in place of i. The rule on the raw text does not fold these letters in either package, but the normalised text reads them as i, so the full evaluation still flags every text. Used by rules_identity_request.test.js and test_rules_identity_request.py.
